meta_title: Sapphire Creators – Marketing nobody has ever seen
meta_desc: Sapphire Creators is a team of developers who code marketing: interactive 3D worlds, films made from code, scroll stories and AI campaigns – cut as precisely as a sapphire.
hero_sub: We are a team of developers. We don't write campaigns – we code them: interactive 3D worlds, films made from code and websites you won't forget.
manifest_text: Most advertising looks like the advertising before it. Same templates, same pictures, same promises. We believe that if you want to show something new, you have to build something new. That's why we're not an agency but developers – and every idea we have starts with an empty file.
stat1_text: Every project starts from zero – with an idea that only exists once.
stat2_text: No site builders, no off-the-shelf plugins, no limits.
stat3_text: Idea, design, 3D, film and development – all under one roof.
services_title: Six facets of finally being seen.
s1_text: Walk-through showrooms and product worlds right in the browser. No app, no download – open a link and dive in.
s2_text: Launch and product films that are rendered, not shot: with real 3D models, original music and voice.
s3_text: Websites that tell a story as you scroll. Just like this one.
s4_text: Copy, images and voices in every language – generated, curated and tuned precisely to your brand.
s5_text: Invitation films, event pages and countdowns that don't just inform people but bring them on site.
s6_text: One source, many countries: websites that build themselves for every language and every market.
s7_title: And everything that doesn't have a name yet.
zoom_inner:
That's not an advertising promise.
It's our job description.
team_title: A team of developers. Not ad people.
team_text: There are no account managers between you and the people who build your project. You talk directly to developers who are equally at home in design, 3D, film and code – and who don't stop until something exists that has never existed before.
r1_text: Interfaces and websites that feel different from anything you know.
r2_text: We model, animate and render products – sometimes before they even exist.
r3_text: Editing, sound design, music and voice. Frame by frame, note by note.
r4_text: Content in every language, pipelines that build themselves, campaigns that think along.
process_title: From rough stone to the first wow.
p1_text: We dive into your product, your customers and your market – until we know what nobody there has shown yet.
p2_text: Instead of slides you get something that runs, early: clickable, scrollable, tangible. Decisions are made on the real thing.
p3_text: Design, code, 3D, film and sound are created in parallel by the same team. No hand-offs, no broken telephone.
p4_text: We take it live, measure what works and keep developing. Good marketing is never finished.
contact_title: Let's build something nobody has seen yet.
contact_text: Tell us about your product, your event or the idea everyone has called impossible so far.
footer_tagline: Built by developers – without a single template.
why_title: Hard on ourselves. Clear in the cut.
why_text: After diamond, sapphire is one of the hardest materials in nature. What makes it sparkle is the cut: facet by facet, every angle true to a tenth of a degree. That's how we build marketing – precise, uncompromising and cut so that nobody can overlook it.
work_meta: Massage studio, Tamm · Website & scroll story
work_text: A site that feels like the treatment itself: warm light, calm – and a moment to breathe in the middle of the scroll.
pj_meta_desc: Selected work by Sapphire Creators: Melanie’s Massage in Tamm, Germany – a website told as a scroll story. Live, clickable, with a before-and-after comparison.
pj_sub: This is what we have built – live, to click through and scroll. No mock-ups, no templates: real sites that are online right now.
c1_lead: What does a massage feel like before you even enter the room? We turned a small studio's website into a scroll story: warm evening light, calm – and a moment to breathe in the middle of the page.
c1_video_caption: A real recording of the live site, scrolled once from top to bottom.
c1_s1: The old site did its job – but looked like many others. Fonts and icons came from third-party servers, and a single photo weighed more than 2 MB.
c1_s2: The site should feel like the treatment: slow, warm, quiet. The entire colour palette comes from the photo of the treatment room – evening light, wood, linen.
c1_s3: An arch that opens into the whole room as you scroll. Treatments that glide past sideways. A breathing pause where the page goes dark. And prices you understand at a glance.
cs1_text: Down from 2,745 KB. The page is there before you get impatient – even on the go.
cs2_text: No Google Fonts, no external scripts. Good for speed and for privacy.
cs3_text: German and English, one click to switch.
cs4_text: From phone and iPad to the big monitor.

ba_after_alt: The new home page: “Melanie’s Massage” in large type with an arched window showing the treatment room
ba_b1: Classic card layout in sage green
ba_b2: Fonts from Google's servers, icons from a third-party CDN
ba_a1: Its own visual language – the colours come from the photo of the room
ba_a2: Everything is served by the site itself: 0 third-party requests
